title: APPLE FRITTERS
instructions: --Beat the yolks of eight eggs and the white of four together. Add a quart of cream. Put over a fire and heat until you can bear your finger in it. Add quarter of a pint of sack, three-quarters of a pint of ale and make a passet of it. When cool put in nutmeg,  ginger,  salt and flour. The batter should be pretty thick. Add pippins, sliced or scraped and fry in deep fat.
